justification: OpenAI credits exhausted (429) stopped the pre-push cross-review. sol_common.chat retries once on DeepSeek via OpenRouter only for a no-credit error, says so, and the report names the model that answered. Live: reviewed PR #1339 on DeepSeek (5 findings, 1 real bug fixed there).

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_sol_common_fallback.py tests/test_sol_adjudicated_findings.py tests/test_sol_review_base.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a no-credit error does not fall back, another error falls back, or the report names the wrong model
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Making the fallback fire on any error failed test_other_errors_do_not_fall_back; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/sol_common.py: live run: cross_review --pr 1339 answered by DeepSeek via OpenRouter

pre_impl.existing_data: OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env (used by the DeepSeek reader)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the report labelled the requested model even when another one answered
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends sol_common.chat; no new client library

functions.name: chat
functions.input: messages, model id, OpenAI key, json flag
functions.output: the model's text; on an OpenAI no-credit error, DeepSeek's text via OpenRouter
functions.if_none: no OpenRouter key -> the original OpenAI error exits as before

break_it.scenario: OpenAI rejects the key (not a credit problem)
break_it.what_happens: no fallback; exits with the key hint as before

break_it.scenario: OpenRouter key missing when credits run out
break_it.what_happens: no fallback; the original error exits

break_it.scenario: a report claims gpt-5.6-sol reviewed when DeepSeek did
break_it.what_happens: the report names the model that answered

mutation_analysis: Changing <= to < in the ratchet fails test_at_ceiling_passes. Removing the ratchet from CLAIMS fails test_oc20_is_wired_with_all_three_parts.
residual_risk: The badge inventory checks each file, not each citation expression: a component with one badge and a second bare citation passes (Sol, 2026-10-17). Hard-wired checked={false} cards always show the mark. The ceiling must be lowered by hand after each proof pass.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach on main prints 21 of 21
